tasks.name: 剧情总结·hide-state 翻转开关
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
(async () => {
    const FLAG = '__xb_hideStateDisabled';
    const T = window.toastr;
    const turningOn = !(window[FLAG] ?? false);

    const { extension_settings, saveSettingsDebounced } = await import('/scripts/extensions.js');
    const ext = (extension_settings['LittleWhiteBox'] ??= {});
    ext.storySummary ??= {};
    const persistFlag = (on) => {
        if (on) ext.storySummary.hideStateDisabled = true;
        else delete ext.storySummary.hideStateDisabled;
        saveSettingsDebounced?.();
    };

    if (turningOn) {
        // ===== 屏蔽模式 =====
        window[FLAG] = true;
        persistFlag(true);

        const { getContext } = await import('/scripts/extensions.js');
        const ctx = getContext();
        const chat = Array.isArray(ctx?.chat) ? ctx.chat : [];
        let flipped = 0;
        for (const m of chat) if (m && m.is_system === true) { m.is_system = false; flipped++; }
        if (flipped > 0 && typeof ctx.saveChat === 'function') {
            try { await ctx.saveChat(); }
            catch (e) { T?.warning?.(`[hide-state] 清理 ${flipped} 条但落盘失败: ${e?.message || e}`); }
        }
        T?.success?.(`[hide-state] 已屏蔽翻转，清理 ${flipped} 条 is_system=true；状态已持久化`);
        console.log(`[hide-state] ${FLAG}=true (persisted), cleaned ${flipped}`);
        return;
    }

    // ===== 恢复模式（on→off）：删标志 + 立即按当前边界重算 =====
    delete window[FLAG];
    persistFlag(false);
    T?.info?.('[hide-state] 已恢复，正在按当前配置重算…');

    try {
        const { getContext } = await import('/scripts/extensions.js');
        const { getHiddenThrough } = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/hide-state.js');
        const { getSummaryPanelConfig, getVectorConfig } = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/data/config.js');
        const { getSummaryStore } = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/data/store.js');
        const { getMeta } = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/vector/storage/chunk-store.js');

        const ctx = getContext();
        const chat = Array.isArray(ctx?.chat) ? ctx.chat : [];
        if (!ctx?.chatId || !chat.length) {
            T?.warning?.('[hide-state] 当前无聊天，跳过重算');
            return;
        }

        const ui = getSummaryPanelConfig().ui || {};
        const store = getSummaryStore();
        const vectorCfg = getVectorConfig();
        let vectorBoundary = -1;
        if (ui.hideSummarized && ui.useVectorBoundary && vectorCfg?.enabled) {
            try { vectorBoundary = (await getMeta(ctx.chatId)).lastChunkFloor ?? -1; } catch {}
        }

        const end = getHiddenThrough({
            enabled: ui.hideSummarized,
            summaryBoundary: store?.lastSummarizedMesId ?? -1,
            vectorBoundary,
            useVectorBoundary: !!vectorCfg?.enabled && ui.useVectorBoundary,
            keepVisibleCount: ui.keepVisibleCount,
            length: chat.length,
        });

        let flipped = 0;
        for (let id = 0; id <= end && id < chat.length; id++) {
            const m = chat[id];
            if (m && m.is_system !== true) {
                m.is_system = true;
                const el = document.querySelector(`#chat .mes[mesid="${id}"]`);
                if (el) el.setAttribute('is_system', 'true');
                flipped++;
            }
        }
        if (flipped > 0 && typeof ctx.saveChat === 'function') {
            await ctx.saveChat();
        }
        T?.success?.(`[hide-state] 已恢复；按当前边界隐藏 0..${end}，重写 ${flipped} 条 is_system；状态已持久化`);
        console.log(`[hide-state] ${FLAG} cleared (persisted), re-applied hide 0..${end}, flipped=${flipped}`);
    } catch (e) {
        T?.warning?.(`[hide-state] 已恢复标志但重算失败: ${e?.message || e}`);
    }
})();
<</taskjs>>
